name: maestro-mobile-template
description: Agentic mobile UI test automation starter template powered by maestro-runner

scripts.test:smoke: MAESTRO_RUNNER_NO_TELEMETRY=1 maestro-runner --env-file .env --driver uiautomator2 test --include-tags smoke tests/
scripts.test:regression: MAESTRO_RUNNER_NO_TELEMETRY=1 maestro-runner --env-file .env --driver uiautomator2 test --include-tags regression tests/
scripts.test:android: MAESTRO_RUNNER_NO_TELEMETRY=1 maestro-runner --env-file .env --platform android --driver uiautomator2 test tests/
scripts.test:ios: MAESTRO_RUNNER_NO_TELEMETRY=1 maestro-runner --env-file .env --platform ios --driver wda test tests/
